subject_name: Aircraft Husbandry, Corrosion Prevention and Surface Protection
topic: Cable system inspection, cable maintenance, fittings, pulleys and wear patterns, Construction and servicing of Bowden cable and Teleflex con
syllabus_extract: Cable system inspection, cable maintenance, fittings, pulleys and wear patterns, Construction and servicing of Bowden cable and Teleflex controls
specific_objectives: 25.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the use of various standards, identification of bolts, nuts, safety methods and maintenance of cables.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Inspection of Bowden cable and Teleflex fittings for wear patterns, corrosion, and proper lubrication application.
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of aircraft control cables?
List three common causes of cable system failure.
Identify the standard safety methods for handling tensioned cables.

development.content:
Cable system inspection procedures
Identification of bolts and nuts
Pulleys and wear pattern analysis
Corrosion prevention techniques

Construction of Bowden cable
Servicing of Teleflex controls
Fittings maintenance and standards

Safety methods during cable servicing
Lubrication application standards
Replacement criteria for worn cables

summary_questions: Explain the significance of identifying wear patterns on pulleys.
Describe the correct procedure for servicing a Teleflex control cable.
Differentiate between standard bolts and safety nuts in cable fittings.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between Bowden cable construction and Teleflex control systems, referencing LP 02 for fastener standards.
